inputs.scene: short front bumper, two axles, centered seat and steering wheel, no driver

prompt: low-poly 3D asset modeling reference, flat-shaded polygon geometry, simple matte base colors. a compact low-poly racing kart with four exposed black tires, one seat and a simple tubular chassis. One orthographic-style three-quarter view shows the front and left side with only a modest elevation. Parallel edges remain parallel and there is no wide-angle distortion. Show the complete assembled vehicle with wheels straight, the chassis level and a readable relationship between chassis, axles, wheels and seat. Keep panels, wheel attachments and mechanical joins simple and physically connected. There is no driver. Construction and pose requirements: short front bumper, two axles, centered seat and steering wheel, no driver. Design details and material colors: matte orange body panels, dark blue seat and frame, gray wheel hubs; large solid color regions. The complete asset fits inside the frame with clear space around every edge, centered on a plain light gray background. Use broad simple polygon faces, clear part boundaries and a small palette of solid material colors. Neutral even studio lighting reveals the forms with only a faint contact shadow. Keep material color separate from lighting: no painted shadows, highlights or reflections in the textures. Show a single asset in a single view without text, grids, measurement lines or a surrounding scene.
